title: IntentResult
description: Gemini's parsed understanding of a natural-language search query. Produced by Cloud Run POST /intent and consumed by POST /search (ranked mode).

query_normalized.description: Normalized/canonicalized form used as the intent cache key basis.

intent_type.description: High-level classification of the user's intent. The enum is closed — unknown values are rejected with HTTP 400. recipe_planning and ingredient_search route to decompose_recipe tool. substitution routes to a similarity search. info is handled conversationally.

keywords.description: Extracted search keywords derived from the intent, normalised to singular/base form. Must not contain WooCommerce category IDs or slugs.

filters.description: Structured filters derived from the query. Only the specified keys are accepted; additional keys are stripped server-side.

on_sale.description: User expressed preference for sale items.

category_ids.description: WooCommerce category IDs. Verified server-side against tenant's real taxonomy — model-invented IDs return empty set, not an error.

dietary.description: Dietary constraints, e.g. kosher, vegan, lactose-free, gluten-free. These are advisory — the server maps them to real attribute filters where possible.

context.description: Situational context extracted from the query.

servings.description: Number of people/servings mentioned in the query.

budget.description: Total budget in store currency if mentioned.

occasion.description: Social occasion, e.g. shabbat, birthday, weekday-dinner.

confidence.description: Model's self-reported confidence in the intent classification. Values below 0.4 cause the server to treat the query as ingredient_search fallback.

cache_hit.description: True if this result was served from the Cloud Run intent cache (5-min TTL).

intent_id.description: Opaque identifier for this intent result — SHA256(normalize(q) + tenant_id). Used as the ranked-results cache key and for trace correlation.
